title: The comparison pullback is exact on sheaves of modules and commutes with cohomology sheaves
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite discrete commutative ring. Let $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ the small pro-etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{et}}}$ and $\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{proet}}}$ be the constant sheaves of rings with value $\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on them, and let $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the comparison morphism of sites, with inverse image $
u_T^{-1}$ on sheaves [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Then:

1. $
u_T^{-1}\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{et}}}\cong\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{proet}}}$ as sheaves of rings, so $
u_T$ is a flat morphism of ringed sites $(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{proet}}})	o(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{et}}})$ and the module inverse image $
u_T^*F=
u_T^{-1}F\otimes_{
u_T^{-1}\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{et}}}}\Lambda_{T_{\mathrm{proet}}}$ of a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $F$ on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ is $
u_T^{-1}F$ with its induced $\Lambda$-module structure.
2. The functor $
u_T^*:\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)	o\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ between the abelian categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is additive and exact (it preserves finite limits and finite colimits).
3. Consequently, for every cochain complex $K$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ and every $i\in\mathbf Z$ there is an isomorphism $\mathcal H^i(
u_T^*K)\cong
u_T^*\mathcal H^i(K)$, natural in $K$, between the cohomology sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] of the termwise pullback and the pullback of the cohomology sheaves. In particular termwise $
u_T^*$ carries quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms, and carries a complex whose cohomology sheaves vanish in degrees $<a$ to a complex whose cohomology sheaves vanish in degrees $<a$.

proof.text: Compose the constant-sheaf adjunction on the etale site with the constructed comparison adjunction on commutative-ring sheaves. Its right adjoint is evaluation at the pro-etale terminal object, definitionally because restriction does not change that object. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the constant-ring isomorphism. Apply the two hom-equivalences and homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to identify its hom with comparisonConstantRingMap.

For an arbitrary module sheaf over the inverse-image ring, define sectionwise additive tensor contraction b tensor m mapped to c inverse(b) times m. Its balanced relation follows from multiplicativity of c inverse and commuting scalar actions. The inverse m mapped to 1 tensor m has both inverse identities by the tensor relation and the ring-isomorphism inverse laws. Naturality of c inverse and semilinearity of module restrictions make these isomorphisms an isomorphism of underlying abelian presheaves. Sheafification and its counit give the required abelian-sheaf isomorphism; unit naturality and the right triangle identity prove the specified pure-tensor formula.

Use the already proved source-library instances additive_comparisonUpperStar, preservesFiniteLimits_comparisonUpperStar and the comparison left-adjoint instance for the three exactness clauses. They apply directly to ModuleCat of the coefficient ring, so no lift to algebraic objects or separate abelian exactness theorem is needed.

Apply ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso to each K.sc i and use mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality on shortComplexFunctor.map to assemble the requested natural isomorphism. Apply HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesHomology to quasi-isomorphisms. Apply Functor.map_isZero and transport along the same homology isomorphism to prove vanishing below every integer bound.

No statement change, no new nodes. Searched project Lean and Mathlib; project exactness declarations cover only part of the item. Checked universe bounds, arbitrary complexes and zero/empty edge cases.

The unit is a definition with no proof steps; no unit route is replaced.

tool_uses.why: Lifts the geometric comparison adjunction to commutative ring objects, before making the constant-ring comparison; no node of this unit supplies the general algebraic-structure lifting theorem.
Identifies ring objects in the set-sheaf topos with ring sheaves so the lifted adjunction applies to actual constant ring sheaves; this is a generic algebraic-structure interface.
Supplies the ring-sheaf universal property of constants used to construct the comparison isomorphism, rather than assuming a scheme-morphism pullback theorem applies to an etale/pro-etale comparison.
Identifies the tensor-formula ringed-topos pullback and its module adjunction for arbitrary ringed topoi; no six-operations step is replaced.
Gives exactness of abelian inverse image for any morphism of sites, used with the comparison morphism, not a morphism between two etale sites.
